Product-owner QA scope change â€” DPI/layout matrix retired as release gate

Effective immediately, all further DPI/display-scaling testing is removed from the QA26 release acceptance scope.

Reason: changing Windows display scaling in the current VM repeatedly destabilizes the interactive guest/control path and can leave the environment difficult or impossible for the owner/automation to control. Continuing scale transitions now creates more test-environment risk than useful release signal.

Authoritative rule

Do NOT:

  • change Windows display scaling for QA;
  • sign out/restart merely to change DPI;
  • launch new 100/125/150/200 matrix runs;
  • recapture missing DPI/layout predicates;
  • rerun executed-but-unqualified DPI cases;
  • hold release solely because historical F-008 scale/theme cells remain NOT_RUN;
  • ask the owner to restore/control the VM for DPI work.

Existing DPI evidence remains preserved exactly as historical Engineering evidence. Do not delete, rewrite, backfill, or infer missing results.

F-008 disposition

The historical 132-cell matrix is now an archived coverage ledger, not a completion gate.

Current preserved ledger remains:

  • 83/132 complete;
  • strict 56/99;
  • best-effort 27/33.

The remaining 49 historical cells are to be classified:

WAIVED_BY_OWNER_DPI_SCOPE_20261019

â€”not PASS, not FAIL, and not NOT_RUN release blockers.

Do not inflate 83/132 to 132/132. Preserve the honest historical coverage while removing the unfinished DPI cells from release eligibility requirements.

Future UI acceptance

For QA27 and later work in this campaign:

  • leave the VM at its current stable display scale;
  • do not alter DPI;
  • perform only ordinary functional UI sanity at that stable scale when a product change warrants it;
  • do not advertise comprehensive multi-DPI validation from this campaign;
  • no scale-specific pixel-perfect release claim is required.

F-020/F-022 may retain their already-established functional conclusions/evidence, but no additional DPI-specific closure work is required. Any still-open requirement that exists solely to prove cross-scale layout is waived by this policy.

Genuine failures are still blockers

This waiver applies only to DPI/layout coverage. It does NOT waive functional failures, crashes, export failures, data loss, security/privacy failures, lifecycle failures, or other genuine product defects.

The preserved native PDF export failure remains subject to Independent QA classification separately.

Frozen QA26 evidence remains immutable:
source 0303a78a06f67252c86634cd73f1e4bda32dd3cc
build 2026.10.02-eng-qa26
harness QA26-F023-PS51-26
latest evidence handoff commit e20ba656882c01c9c4262838f4a76714d995bc05.

Independent QA retains final PASS/HOLD/FAIL.
